messages:
anna: Dropped a proto of the tokens list using 'chip' items instead of rows. Goal is denser info but still keyboard friendly. Thoughts?

ben: Looks nice visually. Quick usability check: how do we prevent accidental copy when users are navigating with arrow keys? chips are small.

priya: Maybe make copy an explicit icon inside the chip, not the whole pill. Keyboard: Tab to chip, then Tab to copy icon. avoids surprises.

design-bot: Accessibility tip: chips should have clear focus outlines and an aria-label that reads the token name + scope summary. Add aria-describedby to link to a status message for rotated/disabled states.

lisa: SR note: never place secret content inside an aria-live region. if copy action shows a toast, the toast should say "Key copied" only. For reveal, open a modal with role=dialog and require an extra click to actually show the secret.

maria: Microcopy: current revoke modal uses scary language. suggest two levels: 1) "Disable key" (soft, undoable) 2) "Permanently delete" under advanced. also show a short sentence explaining consequences.

anna: On the rotate flow, ops asked for less modal churn. Proposal: user clicks rotate -> inline pending row "Rotation scheduled" -> once ready a confirm appears. That reduces accidental clicks.

ben: Inline rows must not reflow the page height. Use a fixed-height placeholder so pagination doesn't jump. Mobile should collapse to an accordion.

priya: Scopes visibility: tiny lock icon on chip that reveals a short summary: eg "Read: bucket, Write: model". Do not dump JSON. Include link to full scope detail.

design-bot: Performance note: don't fetch scope details for every chip on page load. Cache them and lazy-load on hover/focus.

lisa: Screen-reader friendly phrasing for rotated keys: say "Rotated — active until 12:34 PM" rather than exposing epoch. Keep it human and localized.

maria: Bulk actions edge-case: if some tokens are mid-rotation, show a conflict modal that lists affected tokens and requires per-item confirmation. Avoid blanket "all succeeded" messages.

anna: Empty state copy draft: "No API tokens yet. Create a token to start calling Redwood APIs." Primary CTA "Create token". Secondary link "Token scopes explained". Consider adding keyboard hint: press C to create.

ben: Undo toast behavior: make undo keyboard-focusable and persistent for 6s. The toast should not include the secret. ARIA role=alert recommended so SR users get notified.

priya: Quick accessibility microcopy: reveal action should change label to "Hide secret" and have aria-pressed toggle. Add an SR-only sentence before revealing: "Your secret will appear on screen."

design-bot: Small design nits: ensure copy icon has 24px target and at least 44x44 touch area. In compact view visually shrink but keep touch target. Also test high-contrast mode.

lisa: I'll add SR test cases: copy announcement, reveal dialog focus management, toast undo accessible by keyboard, and bulk-conflict modal navigation.

maria: I'll rewrite revoke/rotate copy and send two tone options (soft/firm) for review.

anna: Action items: @ben wire up fixed-height inline placeholder, @priya add scope tooltip mock, @lisa write SR test snippets, @maria update microcopy. Follow-up in design review tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:
